TRIAL:
73.
Every person who commits an offence under this
Act  shall  be  triable  without  a  preliminary  inquiry,  on
indictment by the Attorney General, before a Judge of the
High Court, sitting without a jury:
Provided however,  the Chief Justice may direct that the
trial shall be held before the High Court at Bar, in terms of
the  provisions  of  section  450  of  the  Code  of  Criminal
